title: sundgren.graph/3
description: A map of branches around the tip of a base branch, from `sundgren graph`. Time runs down: one grid row per commit (newest at the top) with a spacer row between commits, one grid column per lane with a spacer column between lanes. The base is the reference lane; the other lanes are the branches chosen by `show`. The drawing is a grid of cells, one character each: `sundgren graph --format text` prints the same grid as Unicode (folded).

threshold.description: Fuzzy threshold of the containment ranking (above 1: exact only).

branches.description: The branches that can be shown besides the base and the `like` branch, in `show` order: those with commits on the page, and the pinned ones. Shown: the first `--branches` and the pinned ones, less the hidden (`--hide`). A lane's `branch` names it.

commits.description: Commits drawn on the page, newest first (by row). A commit on twin lanes is listed once.

folds.description: Runs of commits that can be folded into one row. The Unicode prints them folded.

branch.description: The branch both twins belong to: `feat-b` for `feat-b` and `origin/feat-b`.

label_row.description: Grid row its label goes on: its newest drawn commit, or its connector.

family.description: Colour family, from the branch name so it stays the same between loads; twins share it. null for protected lanes (their own colour). Renderers wrap it on their palette size.

twin.description: Index of the other lane of the same branch, if drawn.

remote.description: A local lane's remote ref when it points at the same commit (in sync): the remote has no lane of its own then.

pinned.description: Shown regardless of rank: the base, the `like` branch, `--pin`.

merged.description: The tip is in the base's history (nothing ahead): drawn faded.

only.description: The branch has no twin at all: `remote` is drawn dashed.

behind.description: Base commits not in the lane.

score.description: Mode `like`: how much of the branch's work is found in the `like` branch's (0 to 1); null otherwise, for pinned lanes, and when a side added nothing.

fork.description: The commit on another lane the lane leaves from; null for the reference.

before.description: The lane goes on below the page (older): how many of its own commits are not drawn. Drawn as an off-board connector at the bottom.

body.description: The message after the subject line; empty if there is none.

refs.description: Branch and tag names pointing at the commit.

lanes.description: Lanes it is drawn on (two for a commit shared by twins).

grid.description: The drawing, one character per cell. Unlisted cells are empty.

cell.description: Lines leave the cell centre towards its connected sides. A lane crossed by a horizontal line is broken around it (`╵─╷`): a via, not a junction.

sides.description: Connected sides: 1 up, 2 right, 4 down, 8 left.

lane.description: The lane whose colour it takes.

node.description: A commit (`commit` gives which) or an off-board connector at the bottom edge (the lane goes on in older history).

show.description: How the branches besides the base were chosen.

mode.description: local: local branches first, then remote ones, newest work first; recent: newest work first; mine: branches with commits by the git user.email first; like: most contained in `like` first (`contain`'s matching).

like.description: The branch of mode `like`; null otherwise.

page.description: How much history is drawn: the base's newest `commits` first-parent commits, and every commit of the drawn lanes since the oldest of them.

commits.description: First-parent commits of the base on the page (`--commits`).

more.description: There is older history: ask again with a larger `--commits` to load it.

fold.description: A run of commits on one lane with nothing else happening in its rows: other lanes only pass straight down. Folded, only `rows[0]` is drawn (the run's newest commit, with the count) and the rows after it up to `rows[1]` are hidden.

rows.description: First and last grid row of the run, inclusive.
